Name: Ebu's CoolDude Sam
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
I've never suffered as much as I did editing Sam, but I do it all for my dream to see him as a.... what I can only describe as a dudebro cooldude beach boy??? I still feel like I'm doing him a disservice by not even trying to salvage his original hair, so maybe I'll go back some day and make an alt version that's more vanilla!

This is 1.6 compatible and sprites are included. Outfits for the seasonal mod are not included yet, but perhaps in the future!
